SELECT count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN home_store_id=900 THEN member_id END) AS online,
       min(valid_from) AS minvf, max(valid_from) AS maxvf, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS jd
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'

calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(*) AS version_rows
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-18' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH first_ver AS (
  SELECT member_id, arg_min(join_date, valid_from) AS first_join, arg_min(home_store_id, valid_from) AS first_store,
         min(valid_from) AS first_vf, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS join_dates
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT first_join = DATE '2026-09-25' AS first_join_is_25, first_vf = DATE '2026-09-25' AS vf_is_25, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN join_dates>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_jd, sum(CASE WHEN first_store=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999
FROM first_ver WHERE first_join = DATE '2026-09-25' OR first_vf = DATE '2026-09-25' OR join_dates > 1
GROUP BY 1,2
